picks.name: Resident Evil
picks.why: Zach Cregger's new take on the survival-horror franchise: a hapless courier is trapped in a hospital outbreak. Expect sharp, fast-moving horror with an ordinary guy in way over his head.

picks.name: Talk to Me
picks.why: Teens turn a séance hand into a party game and get hooked on possession. It's peer pressure and grief made literal, with nasty stakes that keep climbing.

picks.name: Thoroughbreds
picks.why: Two estranged rich-kid friends in Connecticut casually talk themselves into murdering a stepfather. A deadpan, chilly dark comedy about people calmly going along with something monstrous.

picks.name: Our Hero, Balthazar
picks.why: A rich New York teen trying to impress his activist crush follows an online contact to Texas, thinking he can stop a mass act of violence. It's a dark comedy thriller about internet-age self-delusion that keeps getting more uncomfortable.

picks.name: Ready or Not
picks.why: A new bride's wedding night turns into a deadly game of hide-and-seek with her rich in-laws. It's a pitch-black comedy thriller about a polite family that goes along with something monstrous, and it is funny and tense all the way through.

picks.name: Hereditary
picks.why: A grieving family slowly comes apart in a horror film that grows out of guilt, resentment and a domineering mother. The dread builds through the characters, not through atmosphere alone.

picks.name: The Menu
picks.why: A couple joins a dinner at an exclusive island restaurant where the courses turn sinister. A sharp dark comedy thriller in which the staff and guests quietly go along with something terrible.

picks.name: Marty Supreme
picks.why: A hustler chasing table-tennis glory careens from one bad decision to the next. The anxiety never lets up, it's often very funny, and there's always something at stake.

picks.name: Saltburn
picks.why: A scholarship outsider is pulled into a rich classmate's family estate, and the summer turns into obsession. A wicked social thriller about status and pecking orders that keeps getting darker.

picks.name: Promising Young Woman
picks.why: A woman pretends to be drunk to catch out men who think they're the good guys. A dark revenge comedy-thriller about uneasy dates and the people who look the other way.

series.name: The Beast in Me
series.why: A grieving author becomes obsessed with her charming neighbor, whose wife disappeared. A slow-burn psychological thriller about suspicion, obsession and a man who may be a monster.

series.name: Yellowjackets
series.why: A high school girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness turns on itself, and the survivors are still hiding what happened decades later. Teen cruelty, social pecking orders and psychological horror with real stakes.

series.name: The Price of Confession
series.why: A woman accused of killing her husband is offered a deal by a mysterious stranger: to prove her innocence, she must commit a murder. A twisty Korean psychological thriller built on moral compromise.

series.name: Beef
series.why: A road-rage incident between two strangers grows into an all-consuming feud. Pitch-black comedy that keeps escalating, with ordinary people doing monstrous things.

series.name: Dexter: Resurrection
series.why: The serial killer with a code wakes from a coma and heads to New York to find his son as his past closes in. A darkly funny crime thriller that keeps the suspense going episode to episode.
